issue: Terminal-imine CCD descriptor incorrectly treated as contrary observed stereochemistry
trigger: 3PTB BEN C=N1 has no observed terminal-N substituent direction
fix: Distinguish unverified neutral terminal-imine descriptors from observed E/Z mismatches; retain explicit warning and strict observable/override checks
tests: 12 targeted stereo cases; actual BEN pH7 +1 and unchanged heavy coordinates

issue: Author numbering jump prevents missing-sequence detection
trigger: 4BVN author240→275 but only six consecutive missing sequence positions
fix: Use authoritative mmCIF sequence scheme with source residue IDs and ambiguity guards
tests: Sequence-scheme and insertion-code regressions pass; actual 4BVN preparation restores all six source IDs. Separate native 3PTB preparation restores GLY184A, GLY188A and ALA221A.

issue: Valid mmCIF optional metadata causes internal server error
trigger: Generated1K4C tetramer: null chem_comp.type and absent optional auth_atom_id
fix: Handle Gemmi null values and use mandatory label identifiers when optional author columns absent
tests: 23 residue/optional identity tests passed; channel inspection and preparation validation passed

issue: Coarse missing-loop construction can invert newly modeled standard-residue stereocenters
trigger: 4BVN newly built ILE241 and ARG243 fail the strict chirality guard
fix: A single proper-frame placement of only wholly new non-Pro sidechains, with observed/backbone preservation, complete template/bond/stereo/clash checks, low-confidence provenance and required minimization for unrelaxed soft overlaps
tests: Nine targeted controls; actual preparation and eleven independent native identity/geometry checks pass. Failed native build and four bounded diagnostic candidates retained. Subsequent native minimization still inverted two different loop centers; initial-geometry acceptance is not a stable-loop validation. 4BVN was withdrawn and its production run stopped.

issue: Conservative solvent-density estimate falsely rejects a box that fits the local atom limit
trigger: 4BVN rough estimate 105048 exceeds 100000; actual generated box is 87479 atoms
fix: Count the installed TIP3P oxygen lattice before exclusions to bound allocation without constructing a water grid; preserve the actual 100000-atom cap and record template hash plus bound/actual counts
tests: 15 lattice, boundary and large-box controls; 95161 pre-exclusion upper bound and 87479 native atoms at unchanged 1 nm padding; five independent continuity/allocation checks pass

issue: Native minimization can invert modeled residue centers after preparation passes
trigger: 4BVN ASP242 and ALA272 CA inverted before first production frame
fix: Check template-defined local residue handedness after minimization and relaxation, and across saved output frames; OpenMM checks each relaxation chunk and each saved frame. Stop on inversion, preserve failure coordinates, and never publish a successful trajectory. No chirality-restoring bias is added to dynamics.
tests: Four completed trajectories pass every saved frame; native exact-input 4BVN regression stops automatically after minimization at zero production steps; analytical inversion/PBC/nonfinite and retained-history/topology controls pass.
limitation: The 4BVN rebuilt loop remains unsuitable for this workflow; a different complete GPCR supplies the fifth class test.

issue: Checkpoint resume bypassed the current resource profile and could overwrite diagnostic history
trigger: A larger-profile checkpoint could start under a smaller atom cap; a fresh worker replaced previous stereochemistry checks
fix: Validate exact native particle count and current frame, memory and disk limits before resume; retain earlier checks and unique NPZ/CIF failure evidence with hashes. Geometry-rejected jobs require repaired input and a new simulation.
tests: Both engine resource-profile rejection controls and blocked-resume API checks; old checkpoint compatibility; distinct failure evidence with matching native atom identity; nonfinite coordinates remain in NPZ with explicitly marked finite placeholders only in the topology file.
